messages.subject: Work group and Presentation tomorrow
parts:
Hi All,

Tomorrow at D-RUG Martha Wohlfeil (me!) will be presenting a talk on how to build a website using Rmarkdown and Github. This talk will be geared at folks who have never built a website before, as we will be covering the basics. If you are planning on attending, please have a github account created and git setup on your computer so we can jump right in! 

After the talk, we will be having regular work group session.

10am-12, 360 Shields Library.

Hope to see you all there!

Cheers,
Martha 

--
Martha Wohlfeil

Graduate Group in Ecology
Avian Ecology Lab, PhD Candidate
Wickson Hall 3017
University of California, Davis 
marthawohlfeil.github.io
